summary: Envipco Holding N.V., together with its subsidiaries, develops, manufactures, assembles, leases, sells, markets, and services a line of reverse vending machines (RVMs) in North America and Europe. It offers RVMs for convenience stores, petrol stations, and schools; Compact RVM for convenience stores with limited space and low-moderate throughput; Flex, a solution to recycle empty drinks packages; Flex Tri to collect PET bottles, cans, and glass bottles; Optima, a solution for retailers or redemption centers; Envipco Ultra model for the standard-size retail location; Envipco Magna, a high-capacity RVM designed for both indoor and outdoor use; Ultra for larger return centers, such as sizable supermarkets, hypermarkets, and redemption centers; Envipco Modula for supermarkets and hypermarkets; and Envipco Quantum for supermarkets, hypermarkets, and municipal recycling centers. Envipco Holding N.V. was incorporated in 1998 and is headquartered in Amersfoort, the Netherlands.
